title: Convert local times between time zones
summary: Convert one exact local wall-clock date and time between named IANA zones without guessing across daylight-saving gaps or repeated times.

operations.title: Convert time zones
operations.description: Resolve an ISO 8601 local wall-clock date and minute in a named IANA source zone, then return the corresponding instant and ordered target-zone local times. A repeated time must return candidates or follow an explicit disambiguation choice; a nonexistent time must not be silently shifted. The result identifies the runtime time-zone database because rule updates can change historical or future mappings.

errors.description: The canonical request shape, local date-time text, target collection, or disambiguation choice is outside the supported contract.
A syntactically valid named zone is not present in the provider's current IANA time-zone data.
The provider cannot resolve the requested civil-time year within its declared runtime range.
The resolved historical offset contains sub-minute precision that this minute-level Profile must not round.
